name: Meta Setup
blurb: Nine setup cards must be done. Each requires Yes. Verify and go LIVE.

face.how: Complete setup cards 1–9. Each needs Yes. Nothing silent.

help: 1 Open Desk — same login owns all desks.
2 Install World Desk — Give is the file. Install with Yes.
3 Install Automations Account — required for automations.
4 Connect Wallet — MetaMask / WalletConnect. AIA does not hold keys.
5 Connect Meta AI Worker — aia-meta-worker.js webhook live.
6 Drop First Work — card appears in Queue.
7 Activate Additional Desks — any desk this account owns.
8 Choose Mode — Creator vs World User.
rails: Each setup card requires Yes. Yes blocks next.
Worker drafts only. Collect stays HOLD.
